identified risk: Ransomware delivered by phishing could encrypt the finance file servers and their online backups, halting payments processing for several days.
title: Backup and restore
policy intent: Backups of critical systems are taken daily, kept offline and immutable, and restores are tested quarterly so services can be recovered within 24 hours.
control statement: Back up critical systems at least daily, keep backups offline and immutable, and test restoration at least every [90] days.

title: Email filtering
policy intent: Inbound email is filtered for malicious attachments and links.
control statement: Filter all inbound email for malicious attachments and links, and quarantine what is detected.

title: Endpoint detection
policy intent: Servers run endpoint detection and response that alerts the SOC.
control statement: Deploy endpoint detection and response on all servers, and isolate infected hosts within [1] hour.

identified risk: Attackers could phish staff credentials and log in to Microsoft 365 to read confidential email and send fraudulent payment instructions.
title: Phishing-resistant MFA
policy intent: All remote access and cloud applications require phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication.
control statement: Require phishing-resistant multi-factor authentication for all access to cloud applications.

title: Phishing awareness
policy intent: Staff complete phishing awareness training annually and a phishing simulation every quarter.

title: Sign-in monitoring
policy intent: Suspicious sign-ins are detected and investigated.
control statement: Alert on anomalous sign-ins to cloud applications, and investigate each alert within [4] hours.

identified risk: Former staff could use accounts that were not removed to approve fraudulent payments.
title: Leaver removal
policy intent: Access no longer needed is removed within 1 business day of an employee leaving.
control statement: Disable user accounts within [1] business day of staff leaving.

title: Access recertification
policy intent: Privileged and payment access is reviewed quarterly.
control statement: Review privileged and payment access at least every [90] days.

identified risk: Customer personal data could be disclosed through a misconfigured public cloud storage bucket.
title: Public bucket guardrail
policy intent: Cloud storage holding customer data is never publicly accessible.
control statement: Block public access to all storage holding customer data, and alert on configuration changes within [15] minutes.

title: Data encryption
policy intent: Customer personal data is encrypted at rest.
control statement: Encrypt customer personal data at rest using managed keys.

identified risk: Attackers could exploit unpatched vulnerabilities in internet-facing web servers to gain a foothold in the network.
title: Vulnerability management
policy intent: Critical vulnerabilities on internet-facing systems are patched within 14 days.
control statement: Scan internet-facing systems for vulnerabilities at least weekly, and patch critical findings within [14] days.

identified risk: A regional cloud outage could take the customer portal offline for more than a day.
title: Business continuity
policy intent: Business continuity plans are maintained as appropriate.

identified risk: A breach at our outsourced payroll provider could disclose employee personal data.
title: Vendor assurance
policy intent: Vendors handling personal data are assessed before onboarding and annually, and contracts require breach notification within 72 hours.
control statement: Assess and review suppliers handling personal data before onboarding and at least annually.

identified risk: An insider in finance could create and approve fraudulent supplier payments.
title: Dual approval
policy intent: Payments above S$10000 require approval by two people other than the requester.
control statement: Require approval by two people other than the requester for payments above [S$10,000].

title: Daily reconciliation
policy intent: Bank payments are reconciled daily.
control statement: Reconcile payments against bank statements every business day.

identified risk: Intrusions into the payments cluster could go undetected because its logs are not collected centrally.
A distributed denial of service attack could take the customer portal offline during peak trading.
title: Password policy
policy intent: Passwords are at least 14 characters long.

identified risk: Visitors could read confidential documents left on office printers.
title: Secure print release
policy intent: Confidential documents are printed only with badge release at the printer.
control statement: Release confidential print jobs only after the user authenticates at the printer.

title: Clean desk checks
policy intent: Clean desk checks are performed weekly.
control statement: Check desks and printers for confidential documents at least weekly.

title: Shredding
policy intent: Confidential waste is shredded daily.
control statement: Shred confidential waste at least daily.

identified risk: Attackers could exploit the end-of-life HR application, which no longer receives security patches, to steal employee records.
title: Risk-based patching
policy intent: Systems are patched at a frequency commensurate with their risk tier.

title: Security policy
policy intent: The organization maintains a security policy.

identified risk: Ransomware could encrypt the engineering file shares and stop product releases for a week.
title: Backup standard
policy intent: File shares are backed up daily to offline storage and restores are tested quarterly.

title: Backup procedure
policy intent: File shares are backed up daily to offline storage, and restores are tested every quarter.

identified risk: Losing the only engineer who understands the payments settlement system could delay recovery from any incident by weeks.
title: Knowledge transfer
policy intent: A second engineer is cross-trained on every critical system, and runbooks are updated quarterly.
